description: Cloudflare edge cache for apps/landing (nebutra.com and its template, acme.nebutra.com). Applied by infra/ops/scripts/apply-landing-edge-cache.sh; emulated locally by scripts/perf/edge-cache-proxy.mjs. Which pages are public is the origin's decision (apps/landing/src/lib/edge-cache.ts sends Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control); these rules only make the hosts eligible and bypass what must never be cached.

bypass.note: Second layer only: every page rendered per request (pricing, licensing, status in any locale…) already answers Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control: no-store from the origin. These are what must never be cached whatever the origin says: API and route handlers, the docs zone, image optimisation (it varies on Accept, which Cloudflare ignores), the preset stylesheet (it varies on a cookie), and RSC/prefetch requests (they vary on headers).
